name: Blue Silver
live_edge: Book One complete - 15 rebuilt chapters, 34,711 words, all seven gates passing

authority.conflict_rule: Where REBUILD_CONTINUITY.md and bluesilver_codex/ disagree, REBUILD_CONTINUITY.md wins.
authority.superseded: chapters/ is SUPERSEDED - history only, never continuity, never a source for a rebuilt chapter.

spine.lock4: Spirit Hall wants rings, and sends hunters into the forest to take them.
spine.canon_fact_used: Star Dou is hunted. That is the canon fact the rejected original never used.

absolutes: He never kills. No exception, no accident.
Kill count zero across all fifteen chapters and 775 years. Permanent.
A Yin's canon fate is never staged.

timeline.formula: DC is approximately 1837 plus his age in years

anchors.note: Ch2; approximate. The ground he is later born-again into
Ch3 - the arithmetic that founds the mercy law

canon_gate.hard_boundary: Any edit past year 784 breaks canon.
canon_gate.history: The first pass put the naming at year 833 = 2670 DC, which is 49 years after A Yin's rooted era ends. She could not have been rooted in the valley to meet him. Chapters 10-15 were compressed to pull the naming inside her era. Do not undo this.
canon_gate.coda_check: Chapter 15 coda 'in forty-seven years' from approximately 2590 lands on 2637 DC, which is canon Tang San emergence. Delta zero.

refusals.what: The night-walker stops walking and dies at his edge. He does not feed on it.
The old king dies. He could take it and does not.

ground_language.warning: This list is closed. Adding a twelfth word breaks continuity across seven chapters.
ground_language.eleventh: Not a word but a struck rhythm meaning 'I am here, I am answering, I am one of the ones who stays.' Invented by the found one; took eleven years to agree on.
delivery_chain: stamped feet (the found one, then the fringe young, then the hundred at the door)
ground_language.point: The drum outlives everyone who invented it.

named_humans.name: The surveyor
named_humans.contribution: Marks grid nineteen surveyed and unresolved. Her note starts the chain.
named_humans.warning: Her black fourth ring exceeds the canonical optimum. She is a Soul Ancestor, not a Soul Elder. This was an error once made in the codex and must not be corrected downward.

named_humans.name: The thin man
named_humans.contribution: Writes the letter that carries the note forward.

named_humans.name: Pell
named_humans.contribution: Twenty-two years old. Refused the bend.

named_humans.name: Orrin Vase
named_humans.contribution: Walked the round forty-one times. Filed eleven pages.

named_humans.name: Berrit Ohn
named_humans.contribution: Filed the permanent seal in her own name.

the_cull.law: THE LINE WAS HARVESTED, NOT DWINDLED. Never soften this into natural decline.

a_yin.appearance: Gold threading; her face is woven in vines; she has no eyes.
a_yin.age: Youngest of the nine by roughly 40,000 years.
a_yin.secret: The only one who felt the cull's signature - and told no one.
a_yin.constraint: Ordinary grass is empty - she reads through grass, he cannot. He can go where she cannot. Human form exists only from Tang Hao's generation.

identity.is: Sunweave is a real elemental mutant with Adaptation Talent, from a common line.

ending: Book One ends on the words THE KEEPER.

rebuild_history.root_cause: The serial never used the canon fact that Star Dou is hunted.
